program_narrative: FILEHNDL is a batch file-handling template program (source under src/templates/program) that shows the standard open, process, close and file-status checking pattern for one indexed VSAM file and two sequential files. It opens VSAM-FILE (indexed, dynamic access, key VSAM-RECORD-KEY) and INPUT-FILE for input and OUTPUT-FILE for output, checks all three file statuses, performs an empty processing paragraph (2000-PROCESS), closes the files, checks the statuses again and returns with GOBACK. A VSAM status other than '00'/'10', an input status other than '00'/'10', or an output status other than '00' sends control to an error paragraph that displays the status, sets RETURN-CODE 8, performs 3000-TERMINATE again (a recursive PERFORM) and ends the program with GOBACK. The example paragraphs for a keyed VSAM read, a VSAM write and a sequential read are never performed (confirmed dead code) and themselves perform two paragraphs that do not exist in the program.
